purpose: Minimum attribute-assisted global-survey value-of-information probe; last paid survey only

data.date_rule: Earliest 07:00-16:00 observation day; December 2 starts at 11:00
data.membership: All 329 IDs in metadata, including two IDs with no contacts anywhere; class is the sole attribute
data.graph: Simple undirected unweighted edge if at least one 20-second contact on the selected day; no duration threshold

state_generation.global_action_scope: Every registered member not yet queried
state_generation.state_randomness: Independent SHA256-derived NumPy PCG64 streams indexed by split and state; no gain-based state selection

model.connection_model: Beta-Bernoulli, same-class and different-class blocks; Beta(1,1) prior in each block
model.observations: Each queried member reveals all incident edges and incident nonedges; unordered pairs counted once; pairs between two unqueried members remain unknown
model.posterior_predictive: Conditional independence of unknown pairs within two block probabilities; known present/absent pairs remain fixed
model.seed_solver: Greedy k=10 on 100 sampled live-edge graphs of the posterior predictive network, IC p=0.1; all registered members eligible
model.planning: For each candidate, 16 common posterior graph draws. Simulate that candidate's full-neighborhood survey, update posterior, rerun the same seed solver, and estimate final IC influence on the drawn graph minus the no-survey seed set. Drawn hidden graph is never passed to the solver except through that candidate's simulated survey result.
model.final_confirmation: Independent 3000 live-edge samples of the held-out true graph per state, shared across methods and distinct from planning and seed-selection streams

candidate_pool: At most 8 distinct nodes, containing all cheap-rule choices, then filled uniformly without replacement from remaining globally legal nodes; random baseline itself samples from the full legal set
baseline_selection: Choose B* by highest mean independent confirmation influence on 20 development states, fixed rule-order tie break; freeze before reading 80 confirmation outcomes
primary_comparison: VOI planner minus B* mean paired full-graph final IC influence across 80 confirmation states

decision_rules.continue: Mean >= 3.29, unadjusted paired 95% CI lower > 0, and total CPU time <= 6 hours; requires later cost-matched and cross-graph work
decision_rules.stop_for_practical_gain: Paired 95% CI upper < 3.29 on this configuration
decision_rules.uncertain: Otherwise, including time cap, interval covering both zero and 3.29, or insufficient completed states

interpretation: One real static contact graph under an assumed survey protocol. Split units are simulated initial states on the same graph. This is not cross-graph generalization, observed real-world diffusion, or a faithful implementation of IM-META.
